title: Splitness of simplicial objects in SR(C) via degeneracy maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For an r-truncated simplicial object K of SR(C), prove: split iff all f_{phi,i} are isomorphisms for surjections phi iff all degeneracy maps f_{sigma_j^n, i} are isomorphisms: the splitting of a simplicial set is unique and given by the nondegenerate indices (simplicial-lemma-splitting-simplicial-sets), and the coproduct description in SR(C) forces N(K_n) = {U_i}_{i in N(I_n)}; the equivalence of (1) and (2) follows by unwinding the definitions; the equivalence of (2) and (3) uses that every surjection [m] -> [n] is a composition of degeneracies sigma_j^k with k = n,...,m-1.
